All objectives completed and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE**: Ticket `lrn1-n2 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer"), initial status Draft, 0 parts.

**Objective 2 — DONE**: Part `lrn1-n2 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25. App-computed price: **$125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE**: Part `lrn1-n2 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25. App-computed price: **$250.00**. Ticket parts total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE**: Part A's cost edited from 100 → 150 (markup still 25). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. Ticket parts total became $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE**: Ticket status is **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the app refused the first "Mark Ready" attempt with the alert *"Ticket is not ready — Part "lrn1-n2 RD Part A" has no supplier"*. The requirement is that **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. Part B already had supplier "Acme Supplies"; Part A had none. I edited Part A to set its supplier to "Acme Supplies", retried Mark Ready, and the status changed to Ready (the Mark Ready button was replaced by Mark Draft / Mark Closed).

**Objective 6 — DONE**: Both parts deleted (each confirmed via dialog; Parts table now reads "No parts on this ticket yet."), then the ticket archived (confirm dialog accepted; the "Archive ticket" button changed to "Unarchive ticket"). The ticket shows status Ready with an "Archived" badge, 0 parts, and does **not** appear in the active ticket list (verified across both pages with "Show archived" unchecked); it appears only in the archived view.

Nothing created by this run remains active.
